sections.description: Same-origin reverse proxy that keeps the Beexy first-party cookie set (_bx_*) alive under Safari ITP by rewriting the Set-Cookie Domain on a first-party path.
sections.changelog:
0.2.2 — 2026-10-12

  • Update-channel verification release (no functional change): confirms the signed auto-update path end-to-end on updates.beexy.io.

0.2.1 — 2026-10-11

  • First off-gallery signed release; Ed25519 signature verified before install; beexy.com corrected to beexy.io.
